messages:
Anna Chen: Hey folks — PR ready but need cross-team signoffs before canary. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/48212. Change summary: adjust fallback routing weights + propagate KMS headers to auth path. @eng-runtime @eng-security @eng-infra can you eyeball? Target merge window: EOD Wed (need canary scheduled). Risk note in PR but will add details if people want them.
Mike Ross: I can take runtime review today. Quick skim looks fine but want a short perf smoke and a fallback test added.
Sara Patel: Security — I need a one-paragraph threat note (what headers change, who can inject them) and confirmation whether keys are customer-managed or platform-managed. Also call out any KMS/HSM touchpoints.
Teo Kim: Infra — are there any network/egress rule changes? If not, infra is probably fine but want to double-check canary resource requests.
Anna Chen: @Sara keys are customer-managed, envelope encryption via KMS. No HSM. I'll add the threat note + compliance refs. @Teo no egress rules changed, only header propagation in the auth middleware.
Mike Ross: thanks. For runtime: perf looked stable in local sim but add this quick test in the PR:
```yaml
- name: fallback-smoke
  run: ./scripts/run_fallback_smoke.sh --short
```
also set fallback_policy: "immediate" in the canary config so we observe behavior quickly.
Sara Patel: please add an audit log mention and reference ticket COMP-342 in the PR description. Once the threat note and audit log are in, I can +1.
Anna Chen: updated PR: added threat note, audit log line, and COMP-342. Also pushed the fallback-smoke test and canary config change. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/48212/files
Sara Patel: lgtm from security, leaving formal +1 here after CI passes. :white_check_mark:
Teo Kim: infra ok — no infra infra changes detected. +1.
Mike Ross: runtime lgtm. I'll merge after canary completes and we have a quick post-canary check. Can someone reserve a canary slot tomorrow 10:00 PST?
deploy-bot: Canary slot requested: 2026-03-19 10:00 PST — ticket #CAN-9812. Ops will confirm in the canary board.
Anna Chen: perfect, thanks everyone. I'll kick off canary and follow up with post-canary health check. :thumbsup:
